name: 🌭 Sausage, Peppers & Onions Sheet Pan
tagline: Italian sausage, sweet peppers and onions, plus crispy little potatoes, all on one pan.

steps.text: Oven to 425°F with the rack in the middle. Line a big sheet pan with foil.
Toss the potatoes with 1 Tbsp oil and salt; roast alone first.
Toss the peppers and onions with the rest of the oil, seasoning, garlic powder, salt and pepper.
Add the veggies and sausages to the pan with the potatoes in one layer.
Roast, flipping the sausages once, until they're browned and 160°F inside.
Last 3 minutes: split the rolls and warm them on the oven rack.
Eat as a plate, or pile into rolls as sandwiches.

kid_jobs.job: Toss the veggies with oil and seasoning (hands work best)

chef_tip: Give the potatoes a 10-minute head start and spread everything out. A crowded pan steams; room on the pan gives you browned edges.
make_ahead: Slice the peppers and onions the night before.
leftovers: Chop it up with eggs for a breakfast scramble, or over pasta with Rao's.
swaps: Skip the potatoes and serve over polenta
serve_with: Bolillo rolls or a green salad
heads_up: Oven to 425°F; potatoes go in first.

game_plan.what: Oven to 425°F. Potatoes oiled and roasting.
Kids toss the peppers and onions with seasoning.
Sausages and veggies onto the pan with the potatoes.
Rolls on the oven rack to warm.
